title: {RECIPE_NAME} Gradio endpoint contract
description: Auto-generated by tools/generate_export.py. Spring backend treats this as the source of truth. Colab ships Gradio 5.x which prefixes every API path with /gradio_api/ (discoverable via GET /config -> api_prefix). The wire protocol is a two-step queued call: POST /gradio_api/call/predict -> event_id, then GET /gradio_api/call/predict/<event_id> SSE stream terminated by event: complete with a data: line holding the final output array.

path.description: Gradio 5.x queued-call submit endpoint. Returns {event_id}. Legacy /call/predict (no prefix) and /run/predict both 404 on 5.x.
SSE stream. Terminate on `event: complete` and parse the accompanying `data:` JSON array.
Image/file outputs: after the stream terminates, GET the `data[i].url` (absolute URL) to download the bytes. The server's /tmp/gradio/... files are served through this path.

url_env_var.description: Backend reads the actual Gradio share URL host from this env var.

request.description: Gradio wraps positional inputs as {"data": [arg1, arg2, ...]}.

data.description: Position-based input list — matches the parameter order of inference_handler.infer().

response.description: Final SSE payload on `event: complete` — a single `data:` line holding a JSON array of outputs.

data.description: Position-based output list — matches return values of inference_handler.infer(). For image/file outputs each element is a {path, url, size, orig_name, mime_type, is_stream, meta} object; GET `url` to retrieve bytes. For primitives (string, number, dict) each element is the raw value.

oneOf.description: Gradio file reference (image / audio / video / binary)

url.description: full URL the backend GETs to download bytes

size.description: often null for newly-generated files; check Content-Length after download

mime_type.description: often null until after download; inspect GET response Content-Type

is_stream.description: true if incremental streaming (rare for one-shot inference)

errors.description: Failure modes the backend must distinguish.

gradio_url_unset.description: {BACKEND_ENV_VAR} env not set — backend should return 503 to frontend.

gradio_url_expired.description: Colab session ended — share URL invalid. Backend retries against newest URL from {TEAM_CHANNEL}.

vram_oom.description: Model returned OOM — backend should return 413.

model_cold_start.description: First request after Colab restart can take 30-60s. Backend timeout should be >= 90s.

sse_error_event.description: SSE stream delivered `event: error` before `complete` — server-side infer() raised. Treat as 502; inspect Colab logs.

sse_incomplete.description: SSE stream closed without a `complete` event — upstream process crashed. Treat as 502.

_template_marker.description: Recipe authors: edit the `request.data.items` and `response.data.items` oneOf variants to match your actual inference_handler.infer() signature. Keep the Gradio 5.x `/gradio_api/` path prefix and file-dict shape — those are wire-format, not recipe-specific.
